Portrait: A hero costume drawn from Japanese dress: a fitted cross-collar top closed left panel over right, a short haori jacket worn open over it, wide hakama-cut trousers gathered at the shins, a broad obi sash at the waist, padded forearm guards and split-toe tabi boots. Default colors: indigo and white with a vermilion sash, replaced by the character's established costume colors when stated. No lettering or crests. Cut openings for any established wings, tail or extra arms.

Portrait only: inventory and equipped items stay as they are. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; the garment adds no Quirk effect, gear function, rank, license or affiliation. Respect the selected crop.
